warnings.headline: Gale, yellow level, Fruholmen - Slettnes lighthouse, 2026-10-31T11:00:00+00:00, 2026-10-31T20:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: From Saturday afternoon southwest near gale force 7, from late Saturday afteroon west briefly gale force 8. Decreasing Saturday afternoon.
warnings.instruction: Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. If the engine stops you can float towards land.
